caption.text: Part 2 of WEB AUTH HANDBOOK. Most auth bugs are not exotic crypto failures, they are a missing cookie flag, an unpinned algorithm, or a token parked in localStorage for 30 days. This handbook walks the whole wire: sessions vs JWT with real numbers, every cookie attribute that matters, CSRF exploits and their actual defenses, argon2id parameters, and rotation with refresh-token reuse detection. Twelve chapters of dense notes, ending in a cheat sheet you can ship against.
